poses.reference_role: Established legacy neutral Packet Guy identity
poses.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production cartoon presenter sprite atlas for a vertical automotive explainer. The input is IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY, not a quality/style target. Dramatically improve the drawing of this same British-Bangladeshi young male Packet Guy. Natural light-brown complexion, messy black hair under a black baseball cap with a small cyan chevron, faint scruffy stubble, oversized black hoodie with cyan drawstrings. Slim casual human proportions. Stylish hand-drawn 2D editorial/comic animation art: confident dark outlines with tapered strokes, expressive almond eyes with whites, strong eyebrows, angular but natural face and nose, detailed articulated hands, gentle flat two-tone cel shading and intentional hoodie folds. Dry sarcastic personality, not cute baby or glossy 3D mascot. Create ONE sprite atlas, exactly 3 equal columns by 3 equal rows, 9 isolated waist-up figures, each centered in its own equal cell. Keep same face, cap, clothes, proportions, scale and drawing across every cell. No body or hand can cross the boundary of its cell. Keep ample transparent padding above cap and beside hands. Body ends cleanly at waist. High resolution square output, ideally 3072 square or higher. Row 1: (1) skeptical raised eyebrow, closed mouth, one hand near chin; (2) speaking friendly open mouth, casual arms down; (3) pointing UP-RIGHT with extended index finger, eyes looking to finger. Row 2: (4) confused shrug, both palms up, crooked eyebrows, closed mouth; (5) shocked wide eyes and small rounded open mouth, both hands partly raised; (6) unimpressed arms crossed, narrowed eyelids, asymmetrical frown. Row 3: (7) thoughtful hand at chin, eyes looking up; (8) explaining with open palm toward right, mouth open, gaze right; (9) looking up, one index finger raised toward above-right, mouth closed. Genuinely transparent RGBA background throughout. No background blocks, no labels, no grid lines, no text, no scenery, no shadow cast onto background. Do not preserve the crude dot eyes, tube arms, mitten hands or polygon hoodie of the reference. This is a professional redraw of the established identity.

Use the input as exact character identity and drawing style reference. Create one transparent square atlas with exactly 2 equal columns and 2 equal rows: FOUR high-quality large HEAD AND NECK cutouts, same scale and placement in every quadrant, cap above and a little upper hoodie/neck below. Keep the same natural light-brown British-Bangladeshi young male, black cap cyan chevron, messy black hair, dark eyebrows, almond eyes with whites, faint scruffy chin stubble, charcoal oversized hoodie, tapered dark ink outlines and restrained 2-tone cel shading. Do not change face, ethnicity, skin, age, cap, hair or style. Expressions: top-left skeptical raised eyebrow with dry crooked closed mouth and eyes looking right; top-right confused squint and asymmetrical brows, mouth closed, gaze upward-right; bottom-left shocked wide eyes and small rounded open mouth, eyebrows up; bottom-right unimpressed sarcastic half-lidded side-eye, crooked closed frown. Include NO HANDS and NO ARMS, only whole cap/head/ears/neck and uppermost hoodie collar. Make face expressive, never dot eyes. Every face fully inside its own quadrant with transparent padding all sides. NO labels, text, grid, background or background shadow. Genuine transparent RGBA. Crisp professional 2D cartoon cutout artwork matching the supplied atlas.
